APPROVE
`Lex` now has only the loop, three branches and a ternary, well under 15. Every extracted helper (`CommentEnd`, `LexLiteral`, `ScanPrefix`, `LexRawLiteral`, `FindLiteralEnd`, `Blank`) matches the original index arithmetic, termination conditions and blanking exactly. Nothing in the diff should fail a warnings-as-errors build, though I couldn't build it here or check the other partial files for name clashes.
